rca of the issue.issue: iter362 gap: top-level /api/cleanup/* bypassed destructive_admin rule.
rca of the issue.root_cause: Original regex required a literal '/' before keyword branches (e.g. '/cleanup'), but '^/api/' already consumed the only slash before the keyword at top level.
rca of the issue.fix: Updated to r'^/api/(?:[^?]*/)?(financial-reset|reset-financial|reset|cleanup|purge|wipe|danger)(?:/|-|$)' — optional path prefix and explicit terminator.
rca of the issue.verification: curl -X POST accountant → /api/cleanup/split-parts-services returns 403 (was 500 pass-through / handler-reach). pytest test_top_level_cleanup_regex_gap now PASS.
